title: presidio-hardened-ikigov-assess: assessment tool for the IKI-Gov reference model
description: Command-line tool that operationalises the IKI-Gov reference model (Integrated KI-Governance Reference Model) for assessing AI use cases: lifecycle, six domains, six measurement dimensions and six quality gates, with ISO/IEC 42001 and EU AI Act gap mappings. The model is introduced in V. Stantchev, AI and IT Governance (Springer, ISBN 978-3-662-74001-9) and KI und IT-Governance (Springer, ISBN 978-3-662-74093-4). Not legal advice and not a conformity assessment.
